B07C533XCW-886.review_text: I purchased this for my kinda newly natural type 4, low porosity hair and of course I'm so mad that I didn't get it earlier. My bottle doesn't leak, works perfect with every refill and is a time and mess saver for me! The fine continuous mist gets into my strands MUCH easier than with my regular spray bottle that doesn't mist allowing me to use less water and be more direct with my application (if that's understandable). If you're a lo-po and you often spray your hair, GET THIS BOTTLE👍🏽

B07C533XCW-1121.review_text: I filled it with water on the day I received it, to test it. It worked fine. I emptied it and put it away in my bathroom cabinet. Yesterday I filled it with water to use it on my hair and it would not spray. I purchased this because I hoped that for $15 I would get a better product than the $5 bottles but it's worse than the cheap ones. I wish I could get my money back.

B07C533XCW-943.review_text: I've found this spray mist bottle to be extremely helpful in evenly moisturizing my insanely thick, curly hair. Those of y'all who also have untamable curls are probably familiar with the struggle of trying to moisten your hair with a normal spray bottle, only to end up with some sections soaked and some barely damp. This mister is indeed a life saver. Never again will you suffer with clumpy wet hair! I have always mixed a few squirts of conditioner with tap water (no precise measurement) in order to help detangle my hair in the morning before I put it up for the day.

B07C533XCW-213.review_title: It's true, it smells moldy after a few uses.
B07C533XCW-213.review_text: I saw some reviews stating it starts smelling moldy after a while; it took about two weeks for me. The spraying action is excellent, but the smell clings to hair. I tried to empty it every night to dry it out, washed it with soap and vinegar, the smell was there to stay, I had to toss it. I've seen different versions of this mister used by hairdressers, and it never smelled. Not sure what it is. I just switch to the regular spray bottle to avoid frustration.

B07C533XCW-369.review_text: I put water in here mixed with lavendar essential oil to spray on carpet. It has a spray that lasts about 3 seconds with one squeeze so you have to squeeze less times and your hand doesn't get as tired as a regular spray bottle.

B07C533XCW-552.review_title: It releases a powerful mist in one spray.
B07C533XCW-552.review_text: I wanted a spray bottle that would evenly distribute my leave in conditioner and water mixture to my hair. This bottle was suggested by my sister and even though it was a little pricey, it works fine for spraying just the water. It gives a good mist in one spray and evenly damps my hair once I am finished. I would have liked to mix my conditioner, water, and oil together in it. But the manual doesn't recommend it. Stating that it may clog the spray. This limits what I truly need the bottle for. As a result, to pay that much just to spray water doesn't seem to worth it. However, the bottle seems fine, I will wait to see how long it last.

B07C533XCW-1029.review_text: Works great with water. Saw some reviews saying that you had to get versions with a bag to spray any way other than upright, but I've used this sideways and upside down and still had it work. VERY rarely, I'll fill and close it, and it won't spray however much I try; but it's easily fixed by putting the top on--but not sealed-- just enough to reach the water and squeezing the trigger until it sprays before properly closing/sealing the top for normal use. It produces a nice, long mist.

B07C533XCW-158.review_text: This squirt bottle is pretty great. I am always looking for one to either help my kids with their hair before school or squirt water on my ironing. The squeeze handle is easy yet responsive. You can squeeze quickly and get a quick squirt or squeeze longer for a longer squirt. I love it and will be getting more to have on hand in each bathroom.

B07C533XCW-1356.review_text: [[VIDEOID:799c9c88cb6c8a1b419568966bdbeb43]] If you're trying to decide whether or not to order this spray bottle, let me help you out......DO IT!! I ordered one in August 2020, and it's now September 2022 and this thing is still going strong! I have pretty thick hair and like wearing my hair curly quite often (which requires it being damp/wet). Traditional spray bottles were a PAIN and time consuming. One push=1 tiny spray. Ordered this thing and it has been a HUGE game changer! 1 squeeze of this thing is the equivalent of about 5 or more of traditional bottles. It sprays upside down. And 2 years later, it still sprays the same as when I first got it. Nothing has broken and it has not clogged. And I always fill my bottle with regular tap water. I've even put a little bit of hair product in with it on multiple occasions and it has not affected the performance.

B07C533XCW-623.review_title: Save your money. Go with another brand.
B07C533XCW-623.review_text: This product was worthless. It did not work properly and stopped working after using twice. I didn’t return because I don’t want another one. I threw it away and would never buy this item again. I wouldn’t trust this product.

B07C533XCW-1465.review_text: [[VIDEOID:343c36a74d477da774d97cb211236c37]] Love this! Even when full it’s lightweight and easy to travel with. Has a continuous mist as advertised and still allows short pumps of water if that is desired. Love it. I’m going to buy a few more for homemade essential oil room misters.

B07C533XCW-77.review_text: I had purchased one of these bottles a few months back and was so pleased with how it sprays that I ordered a 2nd one for my sister. The mist is perfect for refreshing 2nd and 3rd day curls. It dispenses a gentle mist, not at all like other spray bottles which often drench your hair and require numerous pulls on the trigger. This bottle puts out a great mist and it sprays for a longer period of time with just one pull on the trigger. I am confident you will be pleased with your purchase.

B07C533XCW-265.review_text: Love this bottle!! I needed a new spray bottle and was going to get a normal one. Then I saw this one and the reviews. Honestly, I was a bit skeptical because of the cost and my spray bottle has worked fine in the past. However, having super curly hair, I often wake up with semi-ready-to-go hair needing just a bit of reviving. A normal spray bottle usually adds too much moisture and I end up adding a bit of conditioner and some other products to get them to look proper. It wasn't a problem, it was just the process I'd become accustom to....NOW! This spray bottle is more of a mist than a spray/stream which provides the perfect amount of moisture without getting it too wet and without drying it out...so I don't have to do anything BUT a little misting. I'm buying one for my sister. :)

B07C533XCW-921.review_text: Yes these are expensive, but let me tell you if you make anything homemade from air fresheners, to body sprays, to hairsprays, or even to water plants this is for you and it’s worth every dime! This is honestly the coolest thing I’ve bought an in a long time, and I ended up buying four of them I liked them so much. I use a couple of drops of essential oil and add water and it makes perfect room freshener and calm down spray for my kids !

B07C533XCW-441.review_text: I have never owned a mister/spray bottle and this thing is amazing. Super small water droplets get into hair strands better without getting it super wet. Much easier to manage curly/frizzy hair after a few quick sprays! You won’t regret getting this!!

B07C533XCW-1227.review_text: This is not sponsored. I used my earned coin to purchase this magical product!! I have curly hair and have purchased my fair share of spray bottles to tame my wild lioness hair. This one right here baby does the trick and works like a charm. Believe the hype. It’s good.

B07C533XCW-3.review_text: Has a bad smell. Smells like old stale water. I replace the water every day and I still can’t get rid of the smell.

B07C533XCW-840.review_text: The sprayer worked fine however the water began to smell bad right away. I've tried other misters that did not do that. Not sure if it's the type of plastic or what but I would not recommend this.

B07C533XCW-465.review_title: Use on CURLY HAIR & on Babies' Faces/Bodies
B07C533XCW-465.review_text: We just received this water bottle/mister a few days ago. My 9 yr daughter has coarse, curly hair and we needed a spray bottle for her to use to wet her hair each morning to make combing easier. So far, so good! I chose this product based on its marketing of ease of use... the last thing I need is my kid whining about her hand cramping from pumping a spray bottle (because she definitely would), so I spent the $15 on this one. My kid seems to like using it and I tested it out myself and it really is "less work" to pump than regular spray bottles. In any event, I think $15 is a bit much for a spray bottle, but we like the product, I like my kid not whining and I do recommend this to others. PS: This is also the perfect product to use on little ones on hot days... if you're outside and they need misted to cool down a bit, I would highly recommend this product for that.

B07C533XCW-31.review_text: This thing is super cool. I love it! My daughters love it too! Makes brushing their hair so much fun the way it mists! Great product!

B07C533XCW-1173.review_text: [[VIDEOID:1c3544ca8baa086aae79de02ef922725]] Excelente..me encantó. Tiene dos tipos de rocío : corto y uno que se extiende segundos adicionales Forma profesional, y cómoda de utilizar. 10/10👍👍👍👍👍

B07C533XCW-4.review_text: When hair needs a quick and refreshing blow dry, this is the tool to have! Throw away the water spray bottles purchased at various retailers that send streaks of water down your neck, back and shoulders. This bottle emits the finest mist, just enough to allow you to refresh your style. Learned about it at my last salon visit and immediately when home and purchased. The size is stylish, comfortable to use and is available in both black or white.

B07C533XCW-484.review_text: I received the Hair Spray Bottle in expected time. I questioned the suggestion in the description that the bottle created a "continuous" spray. But I do like the fine mist that it provides when I want to refresh my hair after sleeping on it. My hairdresser had the same bottle but taller and she explained that you had to pump it before you spray to make a "continuous spray." The word continuous may be misleading but in the taller bottle, it was a longer spray. What is important is that it creates a fine mist that refreshes your hair rather than soaks it down. I love the fine mist it creates as opposed to the usual spritz from a regular spray bottle.

B07C533XCW-1126.review_text: I’ve had this bottle for a few months now and it works just fine as far as the continuous mist goes. However, the water gets this musty smell no matter what I do. I’ve tried cleaning it several times, changing the water out frequently, emptying it after every use and letting it air out, and no matter what the water still seems to get a musty smell after sitting for a day or more. I don’t know what else would help, but I wish this wasn’t such an issue.

B07C533XCW-1112.review_title: You still pump to spray but great product. Fits what I needed
B07C533XCW-1112.review_text: This is exactly what I needed. I have a chameleon and I bought the push down from the top to pump type of continuous sprayer and it absolutely soaks everything down to a ridiculous degree. With this it's much finer mist, something my chameleon likes better. It doesn't freak him out like the other type and he quickly heads to his spot to get misted down. One gripe I could have was I was wondering how this product works if you don't continually pump it. How could a non-powered sprayer continually spray off of one pump?.. Well you do still pump it.... It's less difficult than your typical pump sprayer absolutely, but you still pump each time to spray. Each pump though will spray for a short period of time before cutting off, maybe half a second to a second after fully depressing the handle if you pressed in one fluid motion. I like it. I actually ordered this first and cancelled once I'd gone to the store and found the other sprayer I've mentioned. Now I wish I would've just stuck with this instead of wasting my money and having to order it again

B07C533XCW-472.review_title: Stopped spraying afer a week of use.
B07C533XCW-472.review_text: Great while it worked but stopped spraying after about a week of use. I only used water so I would expect it to last a little longer for the price.

B07C533XCW-61.review_text: it produce a of very fine water when spray. bottle is aethetic. build quality is decent Update: clogged after 50 spray or so, returned (5->3star)

B07C533XCW-777.review_text: I like when I take finger off trigger it stops promptly, cheeper ones continue to spray.

B07C533XCW-1044.review_text: Bought this in November and it lasted ~6 months with daily use (mostly for plant misting) until the continuous spray feature, then the spraying altogether just gave up the ghost. Tried many methods to fix the issue, but nothing worked for more than a few sprays. Of course it's cheap and plastic but I hate how wasteful consumerist culture is and how everything is treated as disposable garbage. Reached out to the company via their "contact us" form on their site. Never got a response. Take it for what you will, but I'm pretty disappointed in having to constantly replace every type of sprayer developed.

B07C533XCW-166.review_title: It broke down after a few days
B07C533XCW-166.review_text: It broke down literally after 2 days of using it. All I had in it was water and some aloe Vera juice and peppermint oil. After that it just stopped working and when pushing on the handle it would not spray. Will not be ordering this again that’s for sure

B07C533XCW-854.review_title: The Mist Is Exactly How I Wanted It
B07C533XCW-854.review_text: I love these bottles to spray my curly hair with my water oil mixture when it's time to refresh my curls. Have not tried to travel with these yet, I tried to pack them once and was immediately concerned about not being able to stop the spray from decompressing. Only solution I could've thought of was to put the combination in a different bottle and travel with an empty mister bottle. Was tight on time and have not tried it out.

B00R1TAN7I-1206.review_title: I'd recommend googling some info about them before buying
B00R1TAN7I-1206.review_text: If you've never used a boar bristle brush before (or any natural type of natural bristle, I suspect), I'd recommend googling some info about them before buying. You don't use them quite the same way you'd use a brush with hard plastic bristles. You definitely want to comb the tangles out of your hair first, for example, and wait until your hair is dry to brush it. (Maybe you're supposed to do those things anyway, for all I know -- I have shorter hair so it's easier for me to use brushes incorrectly without too much damage, but I find plastic brushes more forgiving.) Because of those things, I'm not sure a boar bristle brush would be great for styling my hair -- but I didn't buy it for that anyway. I bought it more as a type of hair treatment, to get the benefits of boar bristle brushing: distributing oils evenly, improving the condition of the hair, stimulating the scalp, extending time between washes, etc. I have oily hair, but all that oil just build up on my scalp. With this brush, my hair feels and looks much more balanced. I do get some static while brushing, but it settles down quickly. The brush itself is durable, seems high quality, and has a ton of nice stiff bristles. It feels great on my scalp, and I love being able to help my hair's health without having to slather on a ton of extra treatment products!

B00R1TAN7I-805.review_text: This is NOT all boar bristle, it is about 50% nylon bristles. The inner bristles of each little cluster are nylon, and the outer are boar (or at least some kind of animal). I have included pictures. It is INCREDIBLY static-causing. I am returning it immediately.

B00R1TAN7I-720.review_text: Product came in a damaged box and looked as if it was either used or had terrible quality. Also there are slightly more nylon pieces than boar bristles. Returning. Not going to rebuy.

B00R1TAN7I-57.review_title: hardly any boars hair. do not buy!
B00R1TAN7I-57.review_text: false advertising!!!! the bristles are mostly nylon not boars hair. they are also very short so it will not penetrate hair very well unless you have a crew cut. the bristles are not attached well and fall out while i attempt to use it, the company offers free returns but customers have to pay shipping. buy a more expensive real boars hair brush this one is not a bargain! amazon should check into the deceptive description.

B00R1TAN7I-804.review_title: I did not like it. It had a bad smell
B00R1TAN7I-804.review_text: I did not like it. It had a bad smell, bristles are very thick and hard, and some are falling out

B00R1TAN7I-955.review_text: I wanted to love this brush, I really did. The company that sells it seems awesome. I gave it a fair try and after a two months decided that it's bound for the trash. Here's why: It Stinks! Literally. The first time is got slightly damp, it developed a smell, which transfers to your hair when you use it. Several washings were not enough to remove the smell from the brush. I have been much happier with the $5 Conair Boars Hair Brush that I picked up from my local store (and unlike this brush, which has half nylon bristles, the cheap Conair one is made up of 100% boars hair bristles, and is smell free!).

B00R1TAN7I-681.review_text: First thing I noticed was a very powerful chemical smell upon opening the box,followed by seeing that the majority of bristles were a uniform length/width nylon... VERY disappointing. I feel cheated both by the seller and the reviewers who did not bring this obvious deception to light.

B00R1TAN7I-545.review_title: This is such a crappy brush. I am 17 years old
B00R1TAN7I-545.review_text: This is such a crappy brush. I am 17 years old, and I have long, thick hair. I want to grow my hair out incredibly long so I can cut and donate it. If I want to do so, I must have healthy hair. Boar bristle brushes are extremely good for hair, so I bought one. This one sucks. This is NOT for all hair types. The bristles are so short, making it impossible to efficiently brush thick hair. If you are looking into this brush, do not purchase it unless you have fine hair.

B00R1TAN7I-957.review_title: I find this brush completely useless, and no one I've offered it to has ...
B00R1TAN7I-957.review_text: Unfortunately, I find this brush completely useless, and no one I've offered it to has been interested, non plus. I don't know if it's because I have a lot of thick hair, but it offers no penetration whatsoever. In other words, the brush just touches the outer layer of my hair without doing anything. It feels like a flat surface against my hair, and it doesn't come anywhere near my scalp. The brush does absolutely nothing for me. It doesn't make my hair look the least bit different and does nothing to disentangle any potential snarls or even separate any individual strands of hair.

B00R1TAN7I-178.review_text: I should have heeded the less than favorable reviews on this product. Near as I can tell, this brush is not 100% boar bristle. When I fist got the brush, I ran my hands over the bristles. About ten of them fell out in the sink, they were un-naturally v shaped, folded in half. A natural hair, cannot be made to hold this shape, unless this is its natural shape. Last I checked, boar bristles are straight. Then there was the burn test, hair should ignite and go to a soft grey ash. This curled back from the flame into a ball, that when crushed was very black like charcoal. The brush makes my hair go very flat to my head and have a lot of static when touched. The rubber pad, could be contributing to this. The wood handle is nice. This may have some boar bristles, but this benefit is lost due to the "other" bristles.

B00R1TAN7I-885.review_title: This brush is not for women. The bristles are ...
B00R1TAN7I-885.review_text: This brush is not for women. The bristles are 1/2 inch long and only appropriate for short, short hair. I wish the description had mentioned this detail.

B00R1TAN7I-883.review_text: It's a hairbrush that's made out of hair. Holy moly! Want to know what it's like to brush your hair with hair? Well buddy boy have I got a brush for you, it's this one! Its hair that the fine people at GranNaturals cleverly affixed to a piece of wood. But they didn't stop there, they then took that piece of hairy wood and carved a handle at the bottom. And talk about ergonomics, that sucker feels almost as good in your bald hand as it does on your hairy head! This isn't your grandpa's hairbrush, RIP. This is the new face of hair. Flat, lifeless hair? Buy this double hairbrush. Split ends and a receding hairline? That's entirely your fault and you deserve it chrome dome. Get the only/best/original GranNaturals hairy brush. And if that's not enough to convince you listen to this. Sick of all the brushes in your life. Who can keep track? Well throw out that old brush barrel and make the last brush purchase you'll ever make. Hair feels great on any hair. Heres a LLH(lady life hack) comb down from the top of your head with the GranNaturals Hairbrush Hairbrush, down the sideburns to the beard, over to the neck, around the back down the chest and straight down the "Happy Trail". Lord loves a hairy woman and a hairy woman loves a hairy brush.

B00R1TAN7I-22.review_text: You get what you pay for when buying a boar bristle brush. This brush has a great feel to it, the handle and weight of the brush in my hand work well to guide the brush through my long hair. The purpose of a BBB is not to detangle; it is to stimulate the scalp, spread sebum throughout your length, and use as a finishing brush. One should use a detangle brush or comb before brushing with a BBB. I use the GranNatuarals Boar Bristle Brush in the morning and at night, and I never use it on wash days. It is not a brush to use on wet hair. So, if you know this about a BBB, this is an excellent choice in BBB. Also, the weight and shape of this brush make an excellent hair brush paddle choice. I highly recommend this brush on both counts.

B00R1TAN7I-122.review_text: This made my hair so so smooth. Unfortunately, it also make it very greasy. I looked like a dude for a 50’s movie. Not a cute look. I made it greasy and frizzy at the same time. I had to wash my hair more often then not just to make it look normal. I also feel like this was damaging my hair. I just don’t think this was right for my hair type. Let’s just say I no long use this. On the plus side, the you get what you pay for. The quality is there and it is exactly what you think it is.

B00R1TAN7I-1117.review_text: This product is a very poor choice for keeping brats in line. After only two solid minutes of swatting my 21 year old boy's behind, this product split right in two. Made it even worse when he started laughing. Look elsewhere for your discipline needs.

B00R1TAN7I-397.review_title: A Worthy Brush for a Gentleman
B00R1TAN7I-397.review_text: A nice large brush. No loose bristles. The wood has a pleasing grain. The quality of this brush exceeds the price. Can readily double as a spanking paddle in a pinch.

B00R1TAN7I-606.review_text: I really like this brush, it is a great size and seems to work even better than my other boar hair brush. The handle is nice quality as well.

B00R1TAN7I-485.review_text: I live in an arid mountain environment and this brush has immediately smoothed my hair and already made more shiny! Love it~

B00R1TAN7I-1367.review_title: Using a boar bristle brush requires a little research and practice to get it right.
B00R1TAN7I-1367.review_text: I've never used a boar bristle brush before. At first I was slightly dismayed at how short the bristles are. I didn't think they would get through my thickish wavy hair...and I was right. But I did a little research and found that they aren't supposed to. This type of brush is not intended for detangling. For that I use a very wide-toothed comb. What this brush is for is to distribute oils from the scalp down the length of the hair. This it does extremely well. The best way do accomplish this with my hair is to separate it into sections, and just brush one section at a time. I can't get over how fantastic my hair feels after brushing in the evening and all the next day. I am attempting to get away from shampooing my hair daily which has left my hair in worse and worse shape the longer it gets. So the brush gets five stars. And so does the service. The brush arrived well packaged and in good shape in a much shorter time than I expected.

B00R1TAN7I-235.review_title: Very useful for just daily brushing!
B00R1TAN7I-235.review_text: I have been using these brushes for about 3 years and honestly they’re the cheapest but best for just daily brushing for my hair when I don’t want to detangle every day. Eventually the bristles will fall out and I usually use that as an indicator that it is time to replace my brush. I’ve had one last as little as 6 months and another one last the whole year. My hair before using these was up to my shoulders 3 years ago so it definitely has helped me keep my length with other parts of my hair regiment!

B00R1TAN7I-23.review_text: I actually love the design of the brush, but this brush is not for thick hair! I love the way it makes my hair feel, but it doesn't get all the way through my hair. I'm going to keep searching until I find a Boar a Bristle brush for thick hair!

B00R1TAN7I-336.review_text: I would have given a 5 rating but when I received the brush the bristels on one side of the brush were smashed down due to the way it was packaged (picture provided). Overall, I like the brush and quality as well as the quick delivery.

B00R1TAN7I-562.review_text: Was not pleased at all with the quality of this brush...it had such a strong Oder of chemicals I had to throw out..was not natural boar..had to have synthetic material for that strong of smell..

B00R1TAN7I-136.review_title: She had amazing hair her whole life
B00R1TAN7I-136.review_text: Recently, I remembered that my grandmother always swore by natural boar bristle brushes. She had amazing hair her whole life. This brush is of excellent quality. The bristles are not too hard and not too soft. I noticed an immediate improvement in the shine of my hair and my scalp feels really great after brushing. I'm hoping this will also help with my thinning hair issues. I will report back if I see an improvement over time. Meanwhile, I am very pleased with this brush regardless as to whether or not it can help with the thinning issues.

B00R1TAN7I-707.review_text: The first thing I noticed when I bought the brush was that it had a terrible smell. I hoped the smell would dissipate but it's been over a week and it still reeks. To make matters worse, the smell transfers to my hair. With regard to how it brushes, I have to say I'm disappointed. The bristles only reach the very top layer of hair. I have very thick, waist-length hair and this brush just isn't working for me. I didn't notice that it distributed that natural oils in my hair at all. I've had better luck in that department with the Tangle Teezer. I'm disappointed so I'm going to return the product.

B00R1TAN7I-613.review_title: It does it's job, but could have been designed better
B00R1TAN7I-613.review_text: On the positive side, the brush does help to make my (short) hair more manageable, presumably by distributing hair oils more evenly. But I was disappointed at the clunky appearance of the brush. I have fairly small hands, and the brush seems too wide and over-sized. Of course a wooden handle is durable, that goes without saying. I think the brush could have been designed better, especially with female customers in mind. Also, the bristles are fairly short, which contributes to the impression that the dimensions just aren't quite right.

B00R1TAN7I-10.review_title: The handle is just a large, flat piece of wood.
B00R1TAN7I-10.review_text: It's hard to purchase a hairbrush on line. Picture made the handle look nice, in reality it's kind of crude. Actual bore brushes are okay.

B00R1TAN7I-851.review_text: Its easy to brush my hair. Love it GranNaturals brush

B00R1TAN7I-605.review_title: like chemicals. I let it "air out" overnight and ...
B00R1TAN7I-605.review_text: The brush arrived and smelled AWFUL, like chemicals. I let it "air out" overnight and nothing changed. I tried to brush my hair with it and it only skimmed the top layer of hair. I wear my hair in a ponytail frequently and this brush did nothing to help.

B00R1TAN7I-980.review_text: When this arrived yesterday, unlike normal, I threw away the packaging thinking, "how can you screw up a brush?" Well, here's how. First the brush was shipped in a padded envelope, not a box, so the bristles looked like they couldn't decide which direction to head, so they decided to try all of them. I'm hoping they will settle back where they belong. Next, the smell of the brush, when set free of it's package was HORRIBLE! I left it to air out, and am hoping it comes around, but it is for now unusable.

B00R1TAN7I-5.review_title: but not so good for when you're getting ready for the day
B00R1TAN7I-5.review_text: It's ok as a 'before bed' hair brush, but not so good for when you're getting ready for the day. Made my fine hair lose it's volume and pep... similar to how your hair 'stick's when there's static, but without the shocks.

B00R1TAN7I-395.review_title: This brush isn't like the description
B00R1TAN7I-395.review_text: This brush isn't like the description. I believe it's a well made brush, but it has very, very soft bristles. They don't begin to stimulate the scalp because the bristles are so soft they can't get through my hair. I have fine hair that I cut fairly short (I'm a guy) so there isn't a lot of hair mass for the brush to go through. Having said that, it basically just flattens my hair to my head without separating the hairs themselves and providing a finished, well-groomed look. I'm returning it today.

B00R1TAN7I-1024.review_title: but they feel great on my scalp
B00R1TAN7I-1024.review_text: The bristles on this brush are a bit more rigid than other boar bristle brushes I've owned, but they feel great on my scalp. I've seen other reviews that said the bristles aren't natural- I assure you, my brush is natural. There is a slight chemical odor to the brush, it comes from the mesh used to anchor the bristles. I imagine after a few washes the smell will fade- but even if it doesn't, it's not transferring to my hair...and since I don't particularly enjoy sniffing my hair brush I'm not too worried about this. I think the thing to remember is that although this cost a little more than a standard drugstore hairbrush- this is a boar bristle brush. You could easily drop $250 on a hand crafted boar bristle brush that is perfect in every way. Or... You can spend $13 on a boar bristle brush that has a faint odor. I've had several brushes in this price range and I assure you, none have been perfect and this one is just as good if not better than the others I've used.

B00R1TAN7I-1177.review_title: A hair brush that would have sturdier but semi flexible bristles (similar to the Denman brush) incorporated to help massage the
B00R1TAN7I-1177.review_text: It takes a while to get used to brushing with this boar bristle hair brush. My hair is thick and find it difficult to brush thoroughly as the bristles barely reach the scalp. I wish that they could make a hybrid of sorts. A hair brush that would have sturdier but semi flexible bristles (similar to the Denman brush) incorporated to help massage the scalp for better circulation as well as the boar bristles to make hair shinier and healthier.... I'll be very interested.

B00R1TAN7I-674.review_text: This is an excellent hairbrush and I'm glad I purchased it. It had maybe a dozen bristles fall out when first used and then no more. The bristles (which do not have those horrendous balls on the end) are dense and leave my hair with zero static and a great shine. My scalp is massaged very well and the brush, with its wooden handle and dark bristles, is beautiful to see and display. My reason for not giving this brush 5 stars is that I would want the bristles to be a 1/16 inch longer, the brush handle to be about 1/2 inch longer so it's easier to hold with the paddle itself about 1/2 narrower. (I'm a woman with short hair which has changed texture as it has become 70% silver)

B00R1TAN7I-419.review_title: The customer service was also, I might add, very friendly, helpful, and quick to respond!
B00R1TAN7I-419.review_text: I am actually pretty happy with this brush for the almost week I've been using it! The bristles are good and stiff, so they were able to get through most of the layers of my hair, and it does a seriously terrifying good job of volumizing. Or floofing, in my case. Easily remedied with a little spritzing with water. Or not, if you're into floof. There are a few cons to the brush, but nothing that should stop you from buying it, should you be looking for a nice brush to give yourself a nice scalp massage/shine to your hair/add volume... and other such things. There IS a smell that comes from the rubber bedding that the bristles rest in from using recycled rubber. However, if you let the brush air out after unboxing, the wafting odor goes away. You'd literally have to stick your nose in the bristles to be able to smell the rubber scent again, and it doesn't brush the smell into your hair. Believe me, I've done just that, much to the angst and irritation of my poor snoot. The bristles are juuuuust slightly shorter than I like, but it still grazes the scalp enough to give some nice stimulation (a pretty darn good itchin' relief) to your scalp. I know most people are used to a brush giving the full on scritchin' experience to your scalp, but I find that usually a lot of that, no matter how delicious it feels, usually makes my hair uber oily. Other than those very little things, it's a good boars bristle brush to invest in, I think!

B00R1TAN7I-401.review_text: I have very thick, long hair. It's full bodied, but the strands are about a halfway point between fine and thick. This brush does not glide through my hair. It's only good for superficial brushing (the top layer of my hair), but it will not penetrate to my scalp and brush the buried sections of my hair. A good quality brush for those with finer/less hair, but not for me.

B00R1TAN7I-159.review_title: It's a great brush. Really gets through my hair to my ...
B00R1TAN7I-159.review_text: It's a great brush. Really gets through my hair to my scalp. I'm in my 70's and my hair had gotten dull and lifeless, used to always be soft and shiny. I read that using a boar bristle brush would help distribute the oils from my scalp through my hair to bring back some of the shine. I'm using it daily and it does seem to make a difference. And my scalp feels more alive, too. The brush is well-made and should last a good, long time. Customer service and follow-up is particularly good with this product, too. It's clear the company making the brush wants to do a good job. Refreshing.

B00R1TAN7I-698.review_text: The bristles and shape are as pictured, which is good. My only complaint is the smell. There's a strong burnt rubber smell, presumably from the bristle backing, that hasn't aired out, so I'm going to try washing it. It doesn't transfer to the hair while brushing thankfully, but I get a whiff of it every time I pick it up to use it. I can handle it but I don't have any allergies or a super-sensitive nose, other's may find it too much to bear.

B00R1TAN7I-932.review_text: I am not satisfied with this brush at all. I tried to brush through my hair and it would not touch my scalp as another review had mention. I'm so sad when it comes to trying out things and being disappointed. I have tried a boar bristle brush before and this did not come close to it. For the longest time i always wanted to have my very own boar bristle brushe at an affordable price but this didn't really grip through my hair. The one who I have tried was when a hair style was doing my hair too bad I didn't look at the brand. But after she brushed my hair it was felt so nice soft and silky. I felt like this brush was just petting my hair. Not much grip of hair was caught onto the bristle I would have given it one star but I liked the style of it. I really wanted to love this brush.

B00R1TAN7I-434.review_text: I am in the process of growing out my hair. I hated washing it so frequently, and when it became tangled constantly, I was at a loss. Finally my friends with long hair told me to get a boar bristle brush. Now, I really can't help BUT brush my hair when I am at home. It makes my hair impossibly soft, manageable, and it really does evenly distribute the oil over my hair. I absolutely love this brush and I have no idea how I grew my hair so long and never got a brush like this.

B00R1TAN7I-806.review_title: Great for thinning hair! Doesn’t pull it out by the roots!
B00R1TAN7I-806.review_text: Easy to hold. Soft from roots to end. Very pleased with purchase. Highly recommend if you have thinning hair and loose a lot of hair with a normal brush.

B00R1TAN7I-827.review_title: why does mine look so disproportionate compared to the ones in the photos💀

B00R1TAN7I-1278.review_title: Good product but check the size
B00R1TAN7I-1278.review_text: Great bristles and solid construction, but WAY wider than I expected. Don’t look to throw this leviathan in a small valise!

B00R1TAN7I-253.review_title: Good brush for adults or kids
B00R1TAN7I-253.review_text: Good brush for adults or kids. Brush bristles are on the softener side.

B00R1TAN7I-248.review_title: Make way for a good hair day!
B00R1TAN7I-248.review_text: Given as a gift. She was so excited and even called me to tell me how great it was. It was a hit!

B00R1TAN7I-297.review_text: Very well made brush, easy to hold, but the bristles are so soft. I recommend this to anyone with fine hair or small child but not to anyone with thick or curly hair. Unfortunately the bristles would bend upwards when brushing my hair. This did nor allow the bristles to go through my hair. But would be amazing for people who have tender head or fine hair.

B00R1TAN7I-255.review_text: It pulls the oils through my hair and distributes them creating shiny, healthy hair. No breakage. Gentle on the scalp and hair. Packs great.

B00R1TAN7I-559.review_text: Not made for thicker hair. The bristles are fine and short.

B00R1TAN7I-311.review_text: This brush brushes over your hair. It doesn’t brush your hair. I have fine hair. If it doesn’t work in mine, it won’t on anyone’s. :(( very disappointing. I think a brush with higher and lower bristles would work better.

B00R1TAN7I-581.review_text: I have long, straight and thick hair, I have been looking for a bristle brush to keep my hair shiny and soft. I really wanted this product to be very good. Unfortunately this brush does not meet my requirements, the BRISTLES ARE TOO SHORT AND DENSE, which in my case does not allow a proper brushing, also the product they sent me was defective, when I brushed my hair the bristles came out of the base of the brush.

B00R1TAN7I-194.review_text: Even after letting it air out for weeks and trying to wash it with strong scented soaps I still can't get the funky scent out... On top of that the bristles are so thick that it only brushes the top layer of my hair and doesn't get closer to my scalp.

B00R1TAN7I-1093.review_text: This wasn't a good product. The bristles were all askew and out of order. It just looks cheaply made.

B00R1TAN7I-1265.review_text: Will send it back. Bristles came out.

B00R1TAN7I-1333.review_text: I have very thick hair and the bristles of this brush wouldn't even go through my hair, it would just glide on top.

B00R1TAN7I-715.review_text: I liked it a lot at first, minus the smell. It's not terrible, I got over it. It worked well in the beginning but it's only been maybe 3 months and I feel like It's not working anymore. It's also not the easiest to clean and the bristles tend to get a lot of build up in them. Idk if it's just this brand or if all boar head brushes have these issues but I probably won't re-order.

B00R1TAN7I-653.review_text: I bought this brush thinking it would brush well through my hair. Unfortunately it doesnt brush my hair at all and is very cumbersome to use. Also upon opening it, the brush had a foul plastic odor Several month update: I keep trying and I just keep getting more frusterated. What a bad product.

B00R1TAN7I-1268.review_text: This product smells terrible on arrival. Even after a week airing out, it still smells like something I don’t want to use on my hair.

B00R1TAN7I-400.review_text: it isn't a great brush. It does help remove a little oil build up but only if it really reaches your scalp! I dont know how the brush strands are designed, but its definitely difficult to comb with it. it doesn't give a combed effect ...its like brushing your hair with a cloth that has some thick strands coming out.

B00R1TAN7I-1300.review_text: Smells like fire and the bristles fall out everywhere. Terrible product.

B00R1TAN7I-46.review_text: I didn't enjoy this brush. I'm not able to return it either because I forgot to send it back in time. The bristles didn't even skim my hair because they were so close together. Don't buy this unless you want a hairbrush that doesn't brush your hair

B00R1TAN7I-339.review_text: Although the bristles are fine, I ordered this item because "boar hair bristles" are supposed to be quite stiff. The bristles on this brush are very soft and flexible. But, I must say, I use it every day after my shower. The cushioned base along with the soft, flexible bristles sure make brushing the hair a more pleasant experience especially for us older guys whose hair is not as think as it used to be. :-)

B00R1TAN7I-1302.review_text: I wanted to replace the Boar Bristle Paddle Hair Brush that I had purchased a few years ago. The new brush looks the same but the bristles are soft and not the same as supplied by Gran Naturals. How can I get the "stiffer" version? I enjoy the scalp stimulation.

B00R1TAN7I-330.review_text: Name and harder on brush starting to fall apart. Cheaply made cannot make out maker any more.

B00R1TAN7I-1047.review_text: I hate this brush! Bristles are too short and too close together to effectively brush my hair and I have thin hair! Plus it has a very pecular odor that I could not wash out of the brush! I gave it to my husband to use on his boots!

B00R1TAN7I-595.review_text: Description says its for all hair types - not so. I have short, thick and curly hair, the bristles on this brush are so short they barely penetrate anything! With the shortness of the bristles it may be ok if you have very fine, thin hair. Knowing how men's beards are coarse and thick, cannot imagine it doing any good at all.

B00R1TAN7I-106.review_text: I like it, but it fills my hair with static every single time I use it. On advice from a friend, I tried using dryer sheets with it. That didn't work. Can anyone tell me how to stop this problem so I can use this brush?

B019GBG0IE-596.review_title: Volume, definition, without lots of product - multiple days of fabulous looking wavy hair!
B019GBG0IE-596.review_text: I've never used a diffuser until now and I can't believe what I've been missing out on. My hair dried so fast, with a fraction of the amount of product I usually use, and was not frizzy at all. It was bouncy and beautiful and I got so many compliments on my hair the first day I used it. I usually let my hair air dry with a bunch of product in it but in NYC Winters - that just doesn't work. The picture on my computer makes it looks turquoise and silver AND gold, but you really have to know that the 'metal' looking accents will be brass colored (bright yellow gold) with plastic turquoise. So much so, that I wouldn't even pair it with sterling silver earrings. That being said, I find it helpful to have a costume piece with this coloring because sometimes you need something to go with gold- and that's not a usual combination with turquoise. What else helpful can I tell you? Its very lightweight and the 'stones' are plastic but surprisingly, once on, it looks very nice! I'm thinking it would be fun for cruise or Island wear, wherever you are in very warm climates, because of its light weight. I would not recommend it, however, as a gift, because it 'feels' cheap and lightweight plastic-y when you handle it (even though it still looks nice on).

B012Q9NGE4-39.review_title: Amazing product - for thick hair too
B012Q9NGE4-39.review_text: OK, let me say that I was very skeptical at first, and here's why: I saw that someone mentioned a lot of people were given a free product for their review and I was worried a lot of the good reviews were biased. Then I saw this one review mentioning that it doesn't work on thick hair. But I thought there were thousands of good reviews, and at least majority of those would be true. So I ordered it to give it a try. I have thick hair, and let me say that it works great on mine! It suds up nicely, and has the best aroma I have ever smelled (not too strong, but memorable). If your hair is dirty and greasy, it works better if you put a little bit of shampoo and wash/rinse quickly first before putting more for a more thorough wash. I think I am convinced and might be one of those lifers for the product from now on. If you are like me, don't want to waste a lot of money on product but still want something of good quality, give this product a try. Oh, I didn't get it for free.

B012Q9NGE4-193.review_title: Such an amazing and gentle shampoo
B012Q9NGE4-193.review_text: I think at last this is my Holy Grail! Having finally understood 8 years ago that regular shampoos were poison to my head, and first trying Wen, which was ok but expensive, then various non SLS shampoos, also just OK, and finally this which is truly in a class by itself- if you read the ingredients. Very nice stuff, and so super gentle. The smell is pleasant and mild, does not smell like cheap perfume. My only complaint is that the product is very thick and the pump does not work. I have used this now several times, every other day for the last 2 weeks and my hair is definitely improved. You could certainly use it every day if you so desired. I don't think conditioner adds anything to this, so I probably will use up the conditioner around my house and not re-purchase. This product makes a good 2 in one, for those who like to simplify their routine and de-clutter the bathroom. It is a little expensive, but much less expensive than many other products .You can save money by not washing your hair every day as you probably don't need to, unless you work a very dirty job. I used a quarter size dollop for my very thick, shoulder length hair, but you could probably use less. A bottle should last a couple of months or more. It was the list of ingredients that truly sold me. This has a very gentle cleaner in it and Wen does not. I have suffered with bushy and coarse hair my entire life and this has actually helped. That being said, I have also been gradually shortening and layering my hair to accommodate its' natural flow.

B012Q9NGE4-93.review_text: When I first saw this product on Amazon, I was wary of all of it's good reviews. I have long hair that is prone to dryness and breakage, and have tried just about every shampoo and conditioner on the market to improve hair health. I am pleasantly surprised that this shampoo lives up to it's claims. I want everyone to understand that this is, in fact, a shampoo; it is NOT a cleansing conditioner. In my opinion, that is a plus, as it's important to cleanse your scalp and hair follicles without adding buildup that a "cleansing conditioner" often imparts. This shampoo is sulfate-free and gives a mild lather. I feel like it cleans my scalp and hair sufficiently, without stripping. I color-treat my hair, and this shampoo has never stripped or lightened my color. As far as moisture is concerned, this adds hydration without weighing my hair down. Yet, it is NOT drying to my hair as so many shampoos are. I have long, fine hair, so that's a significant point. If you read the ingredient list, you will see that this product contains many natural oils and humectants. Given that, I am continually surprised that it doesn't weight my hair down. After use, my wet hair feels smooth and sleek, but I still need to follow with a conditioner for detangling. Again, this is a shampoo; it is not a cleansing conditioner. Since there is no matching Pure Body Naturals daily conditioner for this shampoo, I have been experimenting with some other argan oil conditioners sold here on Amazon. No matter your hair type, I think this shampoo can add to your hair health. I highly recommend trying it.

B012Q9NGE4-221.review_text: Have been using same shampoo for years - worked great - now it's something completely different. Has the consistency of pure water. If there wasn't a tamper evident seal I would have thought that someone had returned the bottle full of water, but the seal was intact so this company evidently completely changed the product into some sort of whitish, cloudy water that they are trying to sell as shampoo.

B012Q9NGE4-60.review_text: let me start by saying, I was reluctant about this shampoo because when I think of Argan oil, or any oil for that matter, I think of something that will weight down my hair and make it oily. Therefore, I did not go into this with high expectations. I can say that I was pleasantly surprised!! smell: It smells amazing! seriously, the smell reminds me of laundry. It is clean, light, and pleasant. lather: It was a great lather especially for it to be sulfate free. It lathered well and made my hair feel clean results: I did not use conditioner so that I could really gauge the results. I blow dried my hair per usual and I was really happy with the results. My hair had body and volume, felt very healthy, had some shine, was not oily or dry, and smelled amazing. Day two and my hair still looks and feels great. I would definitely recommend this product. It also makes me feel good using something that has all natural oils and ingredients that I can read and understand. The ONLY bad thing I could say is that my pump is ineffective and doesn't work like it should. however this is not enough to effect the ratings as I just unscrewed it and poured it into my hands. simple fix. I was given this product for free in exchage for an UNBIASED review. This did NOT reflect my review in any way.

B012Q9NGE4-419.review_title: A pump? For this thick stuff? Really?
B012Q9NGE4-419.review_text: I love this shampoo. The product itself is excellent. Makes my long, blonde hair, silky and soft. (See Picture) And it has a very light pleasant scent I can barely smell. What's not to like? The reason I only give it 3 stars is because of the pump bottle. First, the pump is too small for this thick shampoo. I have long hair so it would take 20-30 pumps to have enough to cover my whole head. So... just take the pump off and pour it, right? Wrong. The opening is so large that you get too much in one pour. It makes a huge mess and wastes product. So just put it in a squeeze bottle, right? That's what I did. And it wasn't easy, because you can't pump it and the opening is too large to pour from one container to another without a funnel. So I used a funnel, and slowly, very, very slowly managed to get product into my squeeze bottle and voila! It works great. Now I can squeeze out just the right amount! (See picture) I would definitely recommend this product and have done so. Please offer this wonderful, amazing shampoo in a squeeze bottle. Please?

You can't go wrong trying this Pure Body Naturals product. (Unexpected side effect: the aroma is AMAZING! I have had multiple folks wiggle their nose & ask about my shampoo because of the aroma. I can't do it justice, it's a nutty, natural smell that has an unexpected aromatherapeutic benefit. This wouldn't make me buy a product, but as an added surprise it's lovely!) I have already ordered a second bottle for our second bathroom. You need so little it will last a while, but my whole household wants to use it now so we are all stocking up! Gets my best rating because the price is the last gift. Salon products 4x the cost don't leave such lovely hair! Not something I can say about most shampoos. CONS: - Still need conditioner. I thought with all the oils are nourishing that I wouldn't need a conditioner, but I do. - My hair gets oily faster. When using this, I need to wash my hair more often. I used to get 4 days out of wash and now I barely get two since switching to this. - My hair is extremely static-y! It doesn't matter how much conditioner, leave-ins or serums I apply, I cannot get the static to go away. I didn't have this problem before this shampoo. - Price. It doesn't do anything for me that I can't get from a cheaper shampoo. OVERALL: The fact that may hair gets greasy fast and and that it's so static-y tells me my hair is too dry. I need a moisturizing shampoo. When my hair/scalp is properly moisturized, it doesn't get greasy and I don't get flyaways. I thought this was a moisturizing shampoo with all the oils in it, but I guess they all just get rinsed away, and then some. I will not buy this again because I cannot stand static-y hair.

This kept on me all day at work, even though I had to walk for a good distance in the rain to my car. It didn’t smudge or budge a bit for the entirety of my day and I’ve NEVER had a product that wasn’t eaten up by my weird eyebrows or completely disappeared. This product did it all. A little goes a long way, and the best part was it was so easy to get a natural and defined eyebrow shape that didn’t go over the top or too heavy either. I will be buying all my eyebrow products from them from now on. Best $9 I ever spent.

B07ZJKVVLW-325.review_text: Finally! While a lot of women have sparse eyebrows, menopause completely took mine away. They would constantly be hot, itchy, dry and clear discharge would be oozing down my neck. GROSS! Took less than a minute to get the taper in compared to before, taking over 5 minutes of twisting, pushing, & massaging to get the taper in w/out the balm. Took no more than 5 days to "fully heal." No dry, flaky, irritated, oozing ear. Waited 6 months this time around to size up to 2G. At the same time, my right ear was already infected because I had to replace my plug but I was out in public and only had a spare in my purse. I cleaned it as best as I can but it didnt work. My ear felt like it was back to its newly stretched phase- cracked skin, bump under the ear and clear discharge constantly flowing down. Cleaned my plugs and my ear with salt water then rubbed the balm all over. It started to heal up faster than it did when all I had was salt water & vitamin E oil. Highly recommended for anyone who's trying to stretch their ears.

B074KD4PX2-295.review_text: I used this drill about twice a week on hard gel and polygel nails. I only ever do my own nails but I do them fairly often so I got a moderate amount of personal use out of it for about 8 months before it completely died. This drill itself worked well for me and I liked that I was able to change the direction of rotation. The drill was slim, light, and easy to hold in either hand the whole time I used it. The bits were fairly useless. The softer bits just kicked up fuzz and most of the metal bits didn’t have enough grit to do anything. I had to buy new bits to get any real use out the the thing but for the price I didn’t mind too much. The bit I get the most use out of is the one that holds disposable arbor bands. The drill gave out and stopped moving counterclockwise about 6 months into using it which was unfortunate because some bits not work while spinning in one direction and it can help to switch directions when you switch hands. Just over a month later it gave out completely in both directions and I can no longer use it at all. Bottom line: Yes, it is a good drill while you can use it but be prepared to buy your own bits if you want to get any real filing done and don’t be surprised if it doesn’t last forever. I am disappointed that it gave out, but I feel like the price made it not worth getting angry about. For personal use it was alright but I would absolutely not recommend for professional use. I’d consider it if I were a nail student trying to save where I could.

B08B1PR9C7-67.review_text: [[VIDEOID:6207db919f7f695ffeabe292f31bca65]] This was literally my very first time doing poly gel nails. So simple!!!!! They are just as durable as acrylic. B08B1PR9C7-223.review_text: Where do I start? This product is everything that you see, with the exception of one thing and I'll refer to that later. The packaging alone is amazing. You get this neat sturdy box to keep all your supplies organized. All tools are made of solid material. You're not getting some flimsy products that someone just threw together to create a bundle. I'm very happy with that. I did one test nail to determine the consistency of the gel itself and it's very easy to work with. It's just stiff enough to use the slip solution and it not water down the product. This is very important because once you place the dual form on top of your natural nail, it doesn't ooze out as much around the cuticle. I especially like the dual forms included because they have smaller sizes. My pinky is a size 3 with a nail bed of a 6 year old lol. I finally found something that I really like and works. Now, you see the black envelope in the pic? It's full of surprises and goodies. Such a sweet touch. They included free nail forms. Ironically the same brand that I ordered at the same time I placed this order. And if that isn't enough, the envelope also includes another generous gift of great value but I won't disclose it here. You're just gonna have to get your own to find out 😁 I don't want to spoil it for you. The only thing I found a little disappointing in this kit is the colors. They're a translucent jelly type instead of the solid colors I thought I was getting from other review photos. This is the reason I had to give 4 stars instead of 5 😔. I contacted the seller who explained that this is the only colors they carry but will consider adding more. I decided to just keep it and add more colors to my kit because the overall value is worth it when you include the tools. I'm sure I'll find something creative to do with the colors that came. Support responded to my inquiry immediately. I ordered this product one day and received it the next. Over all, great product, great support, great value. I'm satisfied.

B08B1PR9C7-92.review_text: This was my first time using poly gel, but I am not new to doing my own nails. I am very happy with the product and found it easy to use. You will need a UV light in order to use this product. I was not happy with the dual forms. There was not a size that fit my thumbs and the some of the other sizes were a bit too small, but usable. I would suggest purchasing a separate set of dual forms if you intend to use those. The dual forms that I could use were easy to handle, but I wish that they had guidelines on them in order to make sure the nails are even and to keep from wasting gel. I prefer thinner nails and these came out very thick. I don't know if that was because I used too much gel or if it was due to the shape of the dual forms. I have only used one color so far, but love it. My guess would be that you could get a max of 4 sets out of each tube depending on nail size and length that you choose. The base coat and top coat bottles are really tiny and I don't know if they're sold separately in order to get more. I don't see them lasting as long as you would need in order to use all of the tubes of gel. I did not have any issue with the brush tool and found it to be the proper size even when shaping both thumb nails without the dual forms. Overall, I would recommend this product for ease of use, colors, and price. I give it 4 stars because of the issues with the dual forms.

No upkeep! Of course, you can also opt for the clear gel to form nails and polish as usual, too. Tough, hard as acrylic at a fraction of the cost. Arrived in 1 day!

MY 4 STARS IS FOR: The plastic mold pieces are so curvy! And the durability can vary between the numbered sizes (some super still, some flexible). If you don't have a curvy nail bed like myself, the plastic rises before you cure it and causes air bubbles. I will probably buy some separately from another company, but everything else in the box is really great quality!!! It does take a lot of time to do, and I have a lot to practice, but overall I am really happy I invested in this kit.

I love doing my own nails, its so easy and simple with THIS PRODUCT. Others are too gooey and end up making a mess unless you cure immediately which makes the process a lot longer. However, OPAVE is perfect! You can shape all your nails on every finger and cure it all at once. Not to mention the base and top coat are the most superior of all poly gels out there, I just wish it was a tad bigger! I will buy again, I need more colors! B004H5D40W-590.review_title: This product is amazing. After three back surgeries
B004H5D40W-590.review_text: This product is amazing. After three back surgeries, I could no longer bend well to wash my feet. I especially needed help getting between my toes and washing the bottoms of my feet. Now all I have to do is pour out a little body wash on the top and I'm good to go--no bending required. The suction cups on the bottom keep it steady as I wash. I love that as I move my foot back and forth, the pumice stone also works on my heels. My heels are now baby soft--no dry patches or cracks. I wish I had discovered this product years ago!

B004H5D40W-608.review_text: This product would be great were it not for several design flaws. This will only stick to a completely flat smooth shower floor or surface. So if you have any kind of raised texture or tile shower floor, forget it. Next, when you do have a smooth place, it will not stay put, it slides when you try to move your foot in and out, even though the suction cups are holding to the floor. Also, the bristles need to be more rigid. Put the most painful thing is that the part that goes over the top of the foot is not padded in any way and will irritate the top of your foot after several uses. And the pumice stone in mine broke almost as soon as I started using it. The makers of this product have a good idea but need to go back to the drawing board for the reasons above. If they improve it I may try it again later, but I doubt they will re-do it.

B004H5D40W-706.review_text: The easy feet foot massager works great ,i got the cleanest feet in town.

B004H5D40W-255.review_text: Ok really wasn't sure about buying this. I mean the as you see on TV products are hit and miss - right? But - I have Rheumatoid Arthritis (and Fibro) and sometimes it is hard to bend down in the shower to get my toes/feet. So, I needed some help. I was hoping this would be it. And - I think it is. Now - I have ticklish feet (big time) - so I hoot and holler when using it. But, I fight through the tickle feeling and scrub away. I noticed the first time that it did actually clean my toes and under the toes too. I wish it went up the ankle too and back of the ankle. But - I guess I will wait for another as you see on TV item to do that. LOL LOL My husband actually digs it too and uses it all the time (and he can bend well - but he is tall and likes that he doesn't have to bend or lift his foot up to get the toes cleaned). He noticed a difference too. So, I would recommend this to anyone honestly. If anyone asks me - I would say try it - you might like it. (Oh - it can move around (even suctioned down in the tub) so be careful and take it slow when using it)

B004H5D40W-317.review_title: The good and bad about Easy Feet
B004H5D40W-317.review_text: My Easy Feet $14.95 purchased on their site (EZ Feet site) (buy one and receive one free plus "handling" and postage) cost a total of $30.97 (with their handling fees) shipped to the house, with their standard slow delivery which I approved. The good: EZ Feet seems very well constructed for what it has, and so far the bristles are holding up for me (owned for 2 weeks now). EZ Feet cleans MOST of the bottom of your foot and in between the toes, satisfactorily. With my size 12 foot, the REAR bottom of the foot is rather hard to clean with the EZ feet. The bad: (as I see it) is that the EZ Feet doesn't clean any of the sides of your foot, being there's no bristles on the side, only on the bottom and the front part of the foot. I can't push my foot in far enough to get the rear BOTTOM of my size 12 foot. I have to wash most the top of my foot and all the sides of the foot after using the EZ Feet. It is easier cleaning my foot with the EZ Feet unit, ultimately. EZ feet should positively add side bristles so the sides of the foot can be washed, and a larger footprint (or raise the top bristle armband slightly) so as to allow larger feet to clean the REAR bottom of the foot.

The problem is, its made from hard plastic and there is not much clearence between the top of the shoe and your foot. In the process of scrubbing, it is difficult not to take the skin right off your foot in that area. You must be very very careful. I ordered two but I'm going to have to send one back.

B004H5D40W-395.review_text: RETURNED! First of all, I am barefoot all day long, so I need to clean the bottoms of my feet, but I also do a lot of dying, and constantly have dye spraying or dripping on the tops of my feet as well. So when I get in the shower, I usually end up scrubbing my feet with a brush anyway - I thought this would be great, because it scrubs the bottoms *and* tops at the same time! Yay! What a great idea!.... NOT. Problems; 1. First problem, the suction cups suck (and not in the way they should!) The thing slides around, and is nearly impossible to keep still long enough to get on a good scrub. I spent more time chasing it around the shower with my foot, than it would ever have taken me to just scrub my feet by hand. Even when I was able to keep it still long enough to start scrubbing, every time I pushed my foot into it with enough pressure to actually scrub, it started to move again, and here I am chasing it around the shower again! So #1, bad suction. 2. And this is the worst part! When I was able to push it up against the side of the shower so it wouldn't slide around so much, I don't know if it's because I have high arches or what, but when I put my foot all the way in, that hard blue plastic across the top just scraped the tops of my feet raw! The bristles are fairly soft but diabetics and anyone else who must guard against cuts on the feet should be cautious during use. The attached pumice stone is positioned to work on the heels, but just place the ball of your foot on the stone without putting your whole foot inside if you need to exfoliate that area as well. UPDATE: After more use I agree with warnings that the suction cups DO NOT hold it in place. If standing on one foot is a problem, use this only while seated. If standing, keep your free foot planted firmly and never put your weight on the foot inside the scrubber. It will be very uncomfortable and will probably slip out from under you.

B004H5D40W-698.review_text: Let me start with admitting my biases: 1) I read all the bad reviews, so I had extremely low expectations, 2) I have huge feet (size 14). I contrasted it and compared it with similar products, but this was the only one I could find that could do the main things I wanted: A) Get between my toes (hard to do even by hand!) and B) Get the tops of my feet, too. All the other products I saw only got the bottom of the feet. Found it on sale for $7 and free shipping when I added it to another order, so I figured I'd give it a try. Been using it for a couple weeks now, and I love it! Yes, it does slide a little, but not much if you use common sense (and have a large foot); you're not supposed to put your weight this, you put your weight on your back foot and slide the other one in to wash it. It scrubs my feet great and better than I could do it by hand. Now I said scrub, which I need, but someone with more sensitive feet may find it a little harsh. No more toe jam! And the bonus? Due to the pumice stone, the 20-year-old callouses on my heels were gone within a week or two! I'm so glad I got this, it was definitely a bargain, but maybe I don't expect that much for $7.

B06Y44MMT6-410.review_text: Purchased this product in Oct 2018. Primarily used for misting indoor plants. Very fine water mist and smooth trigger function. Helped the indoor plants immensely. Used it once or twice a day during weekdays. Worked beautifully for about 9 months then the trigger abruptly went from smooth to jammed. I kept on using it because the nozzle was still spraying the mist correctly. That is until today. Now there is just a jet stream that comes out. I will be more than happy to maintain or repair the nozzle myself. But the product designers, intentionally or unintentionally, have made any access to the nozzle parts impossible. Therefore, we the consumers, have no option but to toss the entire product in the garbage and buy a new mister. Agreed, it is inexpensive and agreed it works well initially. But the mister does not have a sustainable and a durable design. The designers should not hide behind the excuse that the parts are plastic. They can absolutely create a modular design where the plastic parts can be replaced instead of tossing the whole bottle away. Creating products that do not last long and create massive garbage is a future we cannot subscribe to. Happy with the product intent. But disappointed in the design thought and durability of the product. Hence the three stars.

B000FEF1V4-109.review_title: Philips Norelco T980 Turbo Vacuum Beard and Moustache Trimmer
B000FEF1V4-109.review_text: I wonder if all these reviews are pertaining to this particular model, some reviews dont sound like my unit. I find no real problem with mine. Nothing is perfect. It is a bit bigger than my old small Wahl, but it has more features that require that. The vacumn works great, which alone makes my purchase of it worthwhile to me; in the past the sink always had a lot of nasty looking hairs all over it. Ive never had mine switch length setting on me, as some people describe, I dont see how it could. I think the adjustable length feature is really great, it accomodates about 'any' length beard, and eliminates all the extra little clip-on guides you have to keep track of. I gave up on trying to take the top off but it doesnt matter as there really is no need. I find no problem with excess noise, or with the turbo setting. Im very happy with mine. Also, this amazon price of $39.95 is $20 less than on the Norelco website, plus you get free shipping.

B000FEF1V4-94.review_title: It sucks. And that's a good thing!
B000FEF1V4-94.review_text: I owned another Norelco beard trimmer with a vacuum in it ... until my wife broke it by knocking it off the shelf. But now I'm glad she did. On the old one, the vacuum was fairly useless because just as much hair ended up in the sink and all over the blade as in the catcher bin. Maybe more. But the T980 Turbo (and don't all guys love stuff with "Turbo" in the description?) does the job. Yes, I know it has two settings: Turbo on and Turbo off. But I see no reason to use it with Turbo off because then it's just like the old underpowered version. But with Turbo on it collects nearly all those little hairs. (Some get away, but many fewer.) Some people say that the Turbo is too loud, which is why they offer an option I suppose, but in our house the bathroom is far enough away and well-insulated enough that no one can hear it running full blast. One caveat: It's better to trim the beard dry not wet. Remember to trim it before you get in the shower because when the hair is wet the vacuum still has trouble collecting the hairs, even on Turbo. Plus showering washes any remaining trimmings away. Yes, this may be self-evident to some of you, but I hadn't thought of it before. Keep in mind I'm doing this before morning coffee. So no more little hairs all over my daughter after daddy kisses and snuggles her. I like the T980 trimmer.

B000FEF1V4-344.review_text: I purchased this to replace a 3.5 year old Norelco T990 when its batteries died. I *loved* the T990 and would buy it again, but it's no longer available. (The current T765 is a similar design to the T990.) T980 issues: The electronic power and turbo switches are touch sensitive and too easy to press while trimming. The settings window is tiny and it's hard to read the number. The mini trimmer is an inconvenient attachment. When using the trimmer without the comb/guide, like for neck cleanup, the vacuum tube blocks your view of the cutter. These were enough to make me return the trimmer to Norelco with their 60-day return policy. There was also an issue that may be a defect in the trimmer I received. It would not hold the selected setting. While using it, it would change to a shorter setting! Yikes! I ended-up replacing the batteries in my beloved T990 for about the same price as the T765. Unless you must have the vacuum and one-hour charge time, buy the less expensive T765. [[ASIN:B0001HYL0M Philips Norelco T765 AccuTrim Beard and Moustache Trimmer]]

B000FEF1V4-349.review_title: Good, not great, with a flaw
B000FEF1V4-349.review_text: The trimmer works pretty well. It trims my beard and moustache adequately and to the length I want, but not on first pass. Most of the trimmings make it into the collection chamber, but not all of them. I would say about twenty percent of the trimmings end up in the sink not the collection chamber. This is a replacement for me for a T990 Norelco trimmer, with a dead battery. I now have to disassemble that trimmer to get at and remove the dead battery for recycling. That is a problem with this trimmer too: it has a rechargeable but not replaceable battery. When the battery no longer takes a charge, as with my old trimmer, the trimmer will not run even when the cord is plugged in. I would prefer a trimmer that is corded, with no battery, or with a replaceable rechargeable battery. What Norelco has done is created a trimmer with built in obsolescence. When the battery is dead, the trimmer is done for. And batteries are not environmentally friendly.

B000FEF1V4-101.review_text: I also wonder if some of the negative reviews are for this particular model (Philips Norelco T980 for $39.99 @ Amazon). -Does not feel cheap at all. -Settings click into place. They will change if you push it to the point where you think you would break it if you pushed any harder. I dont see why anyone would need to push it that hard. I had to test it after reading some of the reviews. -Turbo does not seem too loud at all. -Vacuum works very well.

B000FEF1V4-226.review_text: If you are considering getting this trimmer, all you need to know is this: The 9 lockable length settings don't actually lock!! I tried putting it on length "3", but when I started to trim, it went down to length "2". Then I started on length 2 and it went down to length 1. Besides this, the cutting block is too far away from the thing that touches your face (not sure what it's called), so it's very hard to cut any hair at all unless you choose the length setting 3 or lower. I know all this may come as a surprise to those of you who have had success with previous Norelco trimmers, but the fact is that this thing is a serious piece of Sh_t. In my estimation, their aspirations to achieve the fancy "vacuum effect" has clouded what should be their primary goal with this device: to trim facial hair EVENLY and EFFECTIVELY! I would have given this 0 stars if it would have been an option.

B000FEF1V4-513.review_title: A Vacuum Trimmer that actually VACUUMS!!
B000FEF1V4-513.review_text: I have owned two previous "accu-vac" models. The vacuum always seemed kinda useless, mostly hype. Well.....the "turbo" mode on this puppy REALLY vuccums! If you can tolerate the noise that the turbo mode produces, I would recommend using turbo mode at all times. If noise is a concern, like in early morning, the standard mode does an ok job too. The price is right on this thing, and it LOOKS sweet. 95% mess free. Very Nice!

B000FEF1V4-605.review_text: First shave and my husband lost his short beard. It shifted levels without him knowing it and left a racing strip. Needless to say he had to shave completely. Luckily he didn't trim his mustache. The vacuum works great but that's about it.

B000FEF1V4-316.review_text: If you set it on level 5 and you push too hard, you may not have a beard. The locking system is a joke. The Norelco trimmer I bought 7 years ago has a better locking system.

B000FEF1V4-315.review_text: I've had a regular Norelco beard trimmer for years and when the battery would no longer hold a charge I decided to give this one a try. I didn't really follow the vacuum or turbo descriptions but bought it anyway based on price. Boy am I glad I did! The vacuum makes trimming so much less of a mess. I use it also to buzz cut my hair and there is virtually no mess now where there used to be stubbles of hair everywhere before. I do have to empty the vacuum container a few times but less mess is far better. Great product. The description really doesn't do it justice. It really works!

B000FEF1V4-533.review_text: I agree...with the negative reviews. I really like the guide on Norelco trimmers but that is about it for this latest model. I threw it away 2 days after I received it. I practically shaved off my goatee after it switched from the 3 to the 1 setting by itself. The vacuum doesn't work all that well and if you travel, it is so easy to accidentaly turn this on as it just takes the slightest pressure on the switch to start it up. Bad news all around.

B000FEF1V4-418.review_text: How in the world does this thing get 5 stars? The adjustable trimmer doesn't 'snap' when adjusting to number 2 trim. It also silently switches from trim number 3 - 2 if you press down hard enough. Also the blade has a 'shield' that aids in sucking the cut hair down into the collection chamber. The problem is the 'shield' blocks the head of the blade. Very dangerous if your cutting a line for your moustache-- your literally cutting blind. It does come with a cheap attachment for linings, but I prefer cutting from the blade, like in the older models. Too much of my life depends on how good of a shave I give myself. This time Norelco doesn't cut it. The one star is for the vacuum.

B000FEF1V4-492.review_text: I like the concept of this trimmer with the vacuum and all, but I'm really annoyed that the people who make these things won't tell you what lengths the comb settings will trim to. Even if you go to a store to look at one, they have it all sealed in plastic that you have to cut open just to take a look at it.
