B000FEF1V4-361.review_text: I've had this trimmer for about 1 year now. It doesn't get a lot of use, I only trim about every 1.5-2 weeks (yes, I'm a bit lazy like that). So at most, I've used the trimmer about 35 times. It should work longer and better than that. A few uses ago I went to pull out the little plastic trimmings compartment and the front of the compartment pulled off, leaving the rest inside the unit. It appears that these pieces are just glued together. The second strike is that it doesn't catch about 20% of the trimmed hair, even in Turbo mode. I've tried it trimming very short amounts of hair, or longer. It doesn't seem to matter much. The third strike is that 2-3 times during a trimming I have to remove the trimming guide, and then the blades to remove hair from underneath the blades. I don't see why hair should get trapped under there, but it does and reduces the trimming ability significantly. I don't think I should have to dismantle the trimmer to trim my beard. It's done this since day one. Otherwise, it works pretty well. With some patience and a bit of mess it does a pretty good job at trimming. This is my third Norelco trimmer, none of them seem to have much staying power, my other two had similar clogging issues with the blade, and both had the rechargeable battery die.

B000FEF1V4-383.review_text: Light, good power however design leaves a bit to be desired, e.g., the on/off button and the 'turbo' button are easily and unintentionally turned on or off -- should have been recessed or different switch device used; similarly, the trim adjustment wheel shifts from one setting to another way to easy.

B000FEF1V4-346.review_text: I have owned various panasonic beard trimmers for past 20 years, untli the non-replaceable batteries go bad. This is the first one I have had which sucks the trimmings into a built-in container, which is a great idea. The problem is it clogs every 2-3 strokes, which makes it unusable. Now, if you use this on a daily or every 2-3 day basis, and are cutting hairs taht are 1/8" long, for instance, I bet it would work well. But when you do trimming every 1-2 weeks, and the hair is 1/4" or longer for head hair, it will clog, and this product is not for you. So I would give it 0 stars if you are like me, or 4 stars if you plan on using it constantly, for an overall score of 2 stars.

B000FEF1V4-388.review_text: It's certainly not all that. I've had it a year and a half and the whisker tray already broke. If you empty it every day, it falls apart. If you don't empty it each day, whiskers end up all over the place, including inside the floppy, soft case that has trouble keeping its contents inside. Despite the vacuum action, whiskers collect in every nook and cranny. If you like your grooming aids sanitary, you'll have fun cleaning this thing (and, except the adjustable guide and whisker tray, you can't wash it in water)! Speaking of the adjustable guide, check the setting often, or you'll end up with a surprise...a much closer cut than you expected. The spring-loaded dial adjuster with "digital" read-out doesn't hold its settings as you press harder to get an even cut...it gets worse the more you use it. This is my second Norelco trimmer and the previous one did the same. Conclusion: I wanted Braun-quality to match their stellar shavers (I'm on my third Braun shaver in twenty years of use), but they discontinued their beard trimmer. While the Norelco is certainly not in the same universe as Braun in quality, neither are they in price. The best thing I can say about this trimmer is that at least it's cheap to buy...a plastic throw-away you have to re-buy every year or two. UPDATE: I called Norelco before the 2-year warrantee elapsed. Since the whisker tray broke in two pieces and the spring-loaded beard guide is on it's last leg (thin plastic holds in the "springs" and is very fragile), Norelco decided to replace the unit en toto. They said they'd send a new one out and that I should just put the old one back in the same box, apply the PP label they'll include and drop the whole enchilada in the mail. It's nearly two weeks, and I still haven't seen hide nor hair of the new shaver. Only time will tell if Norelco stands behind their product (and their promises). UPDATE (3/11/09): Well, the replacement unit finally came, after three weeks and four phone callls. Apparently, the thing was on backorder, but nobody at Phillips/Norelco Customer Service bothered to disclose that fact, nor did they provide a tracking number. After my fourth call yesterday, they finally provided me a UPS tracking number which was moot as the package arrived when I returned home from work. So far, so good..at least it works and isn't falling apart. Unfortunately, I have no faith that this one will perform and hold-up any better than the first. At least I won't have to buy another until this one breaks. Update (7/22/09): Well, only four months after receiving the new replacement trimmer, the whisker tray (aka "hair collection chamber") has fallen apart, just like it did on my original defective trimmer. The difference this time is that Norelco is hanging me out to dry and is refusing to do anything to repair/replace this poorly designed and manufactured product. They claim that because the warantee period is up on the ORIGINAL defective unit, that they can do nothing about the replacement unit they supplied, i.e., they won't stand behind the product even though any other new one has a TWO-Year warrantee. FYI, the original unit was bought from Amazon on 4/7/07. As such, I am downgrading the original 3-star rating to ONE-STAR and changing my review title from "It's Just OK" to reflect my true feelings about this product. As such, I will NEVER buy another Phillips-Norelco product again!

B000FEF1V4-90.review_title: Worked well until it broke and cost too much to ...
B000FEF1V4-90.review_text: Worked well until it broke and cost too much to have fixed, so it went "the way of the trash can". Got a different one at Walmart.

B000FEF1V4-544.review_text: The other one star reviews are correct, the auto lock mechanism does not work. It slips down to the lowest setting making this effective only for a stubble look. Too bad, as the vacuum function worked pretty well.

B000FEF1V4-470.review_title: Good Trimmer - rechargeable battery life sucks and cannot be replaced
B000FEF1V4-470.review_text: Trimmer worked great for over a year, then the re-chargeable battery died and couldn't be replaced so no more T980's for me

B000FEF1V4-112.review_text: It died after a year. Worked great when it did, though. Wish it just lasted longer.

B000FEF1V4-77.review_title: I think the vacuum just sucked the life out of the battery
B000FEF1V4-77.review_text: I got this a while back, I think two years ago. It started dying about a year ago. I think the vacuum just sucked the life out of the battery. It did well for me. Just wished it would last longer. The vacuum on this worked fairly well. You have to make sure you clean it often or it will clog up the vacuum and your beards will fall all over the place.

B000FEF1V4-124.review_text: started falling apart after a year.

B000FEF1V4-89.review_text: This seemed like a great idea. Doesn't cut that well if you have a thicker beard. I think I used it for about a month before I gave up on it. You would be better off buying a set of clippers with the different guards and trimming your beard that way.

B000FEF1V4-163.review_title: It worked but could have been better
B000FEF1V4-163.review_text: Not bad but it could have had better vacuum, or at least it could have sucked in hair better. Over all it was decent.

B000FEF1V4-69.review_text: I purchased this for my husband not even a year ago and it worked great. We saved a lot of money on his weekly haircuts by using this. Only problem is it died on us yesterday. No given reason. Never dropped. Never wet. Nothing ever done to compromise the trimmer. It just stopped working. I will say, I placed an order for a new one the QT4070. I hope this one lasts longer...This time, I will keep the box ad the receipts. One suggestion: be sure to save the box and receipts so you can get it fixed or replaced with whatever warranty they offer.

B000FEF1V4-3.review_text: Worked will at first then within the first couple months of ownership plastic parts began to fail, generally when the unit was being taken apart for regular cleaning.

B000FEF1V4-75.review_text: Well, it sucks and it cuts. This is a terrible product. I have owned several other norelco trimmers and this is the worst. The only reason I did not return it is because it will work with AC power. The last Norelco trimmer, the battery life become so short, so quickly that it would not even let me finish trimming my beard on one charge, which is quite pathetic. Pros: Uses AC power, okay triming attachment, vacuume is an okay idea Cons: Loud, high pitched motor (particularly annoying in turbo mode), weak motor if used in standard mode, too easy to accidentally hit the on switch, guard is difficult to put on (doesn't allign easily), cheap plastic cover for hair collector broke after just a few uses. Bottom line: An okay design and a horrible execution. I will eventualy find something else to replace this. I don't understand all the positive reviews. My old Panasonic was awesome and lasted several years but died last year and I can't find a good replacement that will also use AC power.

B000FEF1V4-502.review_text: I purchased this norelco to trim the hair on my head. I had an older model and it worked great. The length selector doesn't lock and I ended up cutting my hair too short. It's just an OK product. I know it may not be designed to cut head hair but, I thought it would work as well as the older model. I guess I was wrong. I would only buy this if I was cutting facial hair only.

B000GBMYC0-30.review_text: If you've been reading any of the reviews here lately you will know the 8000 series foil/cutterblock combo has been replaced with a new combo now called the series 5 Combi 51S. You will receive this replacement even if the picture on the product page shows "8000 series" as it has been discontinued for over a year. Braun merged the replacement for the 8000 series (Activator) with the 360 Complete. This new foil/cutterblock is garbage! The cutterblock has wide blades, as opposed to the thinner blades of the original 8000 series, which pull your stubble and take MANY passes over your face to shave. They are prone to premature failure and I have gone through 3(THREE) of these in 6 months! (I bought one and two were free through Braun after complaining). All the free replacements in the world weren't making the shaving experience any better. I longed for the days when my Activator 8595 cut smooth, close, and comfortably. After all, this shaver had been my favorite for 6 years so far! I was very close to dumping the whole shaver and moving on when I happened across a reviewer on Amazon who suggested using the 7000 series replacement foil/cutterblock in his review. It worked PERFECTLY! The 7000 series replacement looks just like the much coveted original on my 8595 Activator - down to the thinner cutting blades! It didn't pull my stubble, it cut smooth as butter, and was comfortable: JUST LIKE NEW! I'd like to thank the original reviewer (James L. Walls "sixtoe") for the very good advice. ***Update: August 10th, 2011*** I hope people are happy with the replacement I recommended. I sure am! I just wanted to update the product link for the better replacement: [[ASIN:B001VH6F9G Braun Series 3 Combi 30B Foil and Cutter Replacement Pack (Formerly 4700,7000)]] ***Update: January 13, 2013*** Unfortunately, the Braun 30B Foil and Cutter Replacement Pack is now the same terrible cutter block design as the series 5 (8000 replacement). I ordered another 30B to replace the one I bought 2.5 years ago and was highly disappointed when the package came. I will have to do some research to see if any of Braun's other replacements are the good, narrow blade versions. I have read some reports that the narrow cutting block is available, but without the foil. If I cannot find a narrow blade replacement I am going to throw in the towel after 8 years of service from this shaver. Shame on Braun for putting out those ill performing wide blade cutting blocks. Terrible... ***Update: January 18, 2013*** It appears the highly elusive narrow blade cutter block can be found on the 31S replacement pack. The unfortunate news is the included foil is not compatible. Therefore, a replacement foil for the 8000 series/Activator/7000 series/360 Complete would be needed in conjunction with the quality cutter block effectively doubling your cost because it is difficult to find the foil sold by itself. This would be a combined expense of roughly $55-$60 in order to bring your shaver back to the "like new" shave we all want. Remember - the "direct" replacement combo for this shaver series will leave you highly disappointed due to the WIDE cutter block which pulls hair and easily nicks skin. Another facet to influence your decision in spending $60 to refresh your Braun is many of these shavers - due to their age - are in need of new motors and potentially batteries. The motors gradually slow down with time and I noticed a HUGE difference when I replaced mine 2 years ago. Now, these motors are almost impossible to find at this point and for me, personally, it is getting to the point of diminished returns. I hope this post helps you in both informing you of the available narrow cutter block, but also in weighing your decision in either keeping your Braun chugging along or researching a new alternative.

B000GBMYC0-278.review_text: SEE BOTTOM FOR MY UPDATE: Is the 51s foil and cutter really terrible? Is the 30B foil and cutter really better for your Braun Series 8000 shaver? Is there an Original Equipment foil and cutter still available for the Braun 8985 shaver? Answers: no, no, and no. I have the Braun 8985 shaver and bought BOTH of the foils and cutters mentioned in these reviews: the 51s, which Braun sells as its only replacement now for the 8000 series, and the 30b, which is supposed to be for the Braun 7000/4000 series shavers, but some buyers are saying it works better for the 8000 series shavers than the so-called "terrible" 51s replacement. Both foils and cutters fit my 8985 shavers, and I've shaved serveral times with both. The 51s does NOT pull, cut or irritate my face and gives a very close shave, particularly if I have a 2-day beard. The 30b also gives a good shave, but perhaps not quite as close. Some reviewers say the 51s wears out quickly, is prone to dents and starts irritating your face. If that happens, I will update this review, but so far, so good. I ordered the 51s by mistake because the seller's web listing did not mention that its "Braun 8000 360 Complete Foil and Cutter Block for Models 8995, 8985 and 8975" is really the controversial 51s replacement. When it arrived with the dreaded 51s name on the package, I immediately ordered the 30b foil and cutter and planned to return the 51s, but I waited until the 30b arrived so I could be sure it worked. It does, but it buzzes differently and didn't shave much closer than my 3-year-old original foil and cutter. The 30b DOES give a more comfortable shave -- it glides over your face like nothing is happening. The shave is fine, what you'd expect from any electric. But Braun is better than "any electric." The 51s is giving me that exceptionally close shave I expect from Braun. You DO feel the 51s a bit more than the 30b, but it's not irritating. I am keeping the 30b in case my 51s goes haywire on me, but for now, the 51s seems better. UPDATE May 6, 2012: I'm glad I kept the 30b because the 51s did indeed start inflicting red marks on my face, and it stopped shaving as closely. Very disappointing. So now I'm using the 30b, the red marks on my face are gone, and the shave is close. So if I had it to do all over again, I would recommend getting tthe 30b foil and cutter instead of the 51s.

B000GBMYC0-456.review_title: Review of 51S foil and cutter for Braun shaver
B000GBMYC0-456.review_text: Just my .2 cents. I have a Braun model #8985 Series 5. After a year of satisfactory use, I thought I should replace the foil and cutters. I got the one recommended for my shaver, the 51S. I started to use it, and after just a few shaves, I noticed the shaves were not as smooth, and more irritation to my face, than I was getting with my original shaver I had for the past year. Now just after a few shaves, I noticed my cutter was starting to dull. I stuck with it a few more months, and then I started looking for a better cutting block for it. I came on Amazon and read some reviews, and there were many satisfied users of the 30B kit. . I even called Braun, and told them my situation, and asked if I could change over to the 30B, instead of staying with the 51S. NO WAY said the rep, use only the cartridge recommended by Braun, the 51S. Well, I decided otherwise, and went to "Target", and got the 30B replacement foil and cutter. Boy, what a difference. It fits right in, no problem with the foil or the cutter fitting, I even like the foil better than the 51S, seems to roll over my fact smoother. The shaves seem so much better. Now to be honest, I have not used the razor much yet, but I'll get back to you with my thoughts when I do. On my #8985 there is a light that comes on, and it says "change foil", which came on right then when I changed the foil over to the 30B, it lite up. There is a reset button right there, and if you push it with a pen or pencil point, the light goes out after blinking a few times. Maybe the 30B is the way to go, and the 30B is about $15 cheaper than the 51S. I don't know what Braun is doing, but it is not making me buy a new Braun. If I get upset with their shaver, I'm not going to buy a new Braun, I will switch brands. Hate to say this folks, but every manufacturer out there is trying to rip us off today! Regards, TC

B000GBMYC0-84.review_title: I wish I owned the factory that makes these things...
B000GBMYC0-84.review_text: This is a factory replacement part for several models of Braun shavers, so it fits perfectly, and it works just like the original part. The bad news is the price. You'll hold it in your hand and say, "How could this thing cost $30!?" Well, it just does; if you want the factory part, you have to pay the factory price. There is no after-market replacement. Do you even need to replace the cutter assembly? Probably so. Obviously, if you dent the original by fumbling your shaver, you'll need a replacement. However, even with perfect care, the original cutter wears out in about 18 months. If you pop the foil cover off of your shaver, you can see why: The blades run back and forth against the foil cover, shearing off the whiskers that have protruded into the tiny holes and slots. Eighteen months of friction does the damage. So, if you want the Braun shaver-- which, by the way is excellent-- then you just have to buy the parts needed to do the periodic maintenance. Life is like that sometimes...

B000GBMYC0-561.review_text: Braun says that these blades work with the 8595 that I use. While it's true that the blades do fit and the razor will operate, the level of razor burn is OFF THE SCALE compared to the Activator blades. The best thing about the Braun system is the minimal to non-existent razor burn, an advantage that is completely lost with these. If you use an 8595, avoid these blades like the plague. (Frankly, I would assume that these blades would cause the same problems with other Braun razors, but I can't say for sure since all I have is an 8595.)

B000GBMYC0-383.review_text: There are a lot of posts about this item and the series 3 replacement foil and cutter. They both work on a variety of Braun shavers, and I have the 8995 model. I've had it for a decade or more I think and at one time the Series 3 replacement parts worked better than the Series 5, but the last few times I bought the series 3, it just didn't seem to be as good as I remembered. So, I bought both this time, the series 3 and series 5. I can tell no difference in the shave with either and they both are worse than what I used to get. I believe the information about the cutters now having thicker blades is probably the issue. They cutters for the 2 items appear to be identical and the blades do look thick. It still does perform really well and if I take the extra time to go over my beard multiple times, it turns out OK. However, I'm disappointed that I'll probably have to start shopping for a whole new razor soon to get the cut I desire, or just switch back to manual blades. Hope this helps others.

B000GBMYC0-381.review_title: no pulling - just like when the razor was new (but I had forgotten ...
B000GBMYC0-381.review_text: Initially, I thought Braun was pushing blade replacement as just another way to make money, but the old blade set eventually broke and I was forced to get new ones. What a difference they make! As the old set wore down, the shave became harder and took longer - and was more uncomfortable. The problem was that it happened so gradually, I never really noticed it. The first shave after the new blades were installed was a revelation - smooth, no pulling - just like when the razor was new (but I had forgotten about). If you have a Braun with old blades, changing them can make a huge difference in comfort and performance.

B000GBMYC0-334.review_text: I've had my Braun 8595 for 5 years. I LOVED MY BRAUN!!! It was worth every penny of the original purchase price, and the cost of previous replacement foils. I went to buy my third set of replacement foils to discover the Model 8000 Activator, the original shaver foil and cutter block, had been discontinued and replaced with the 360* Complete, so I bought that. Braun had been great, and never let me down before. I have fairly tough skin, but this new head caused horrible, painful razor burn. It's the worst on the neck, but it causes it everywhere. Rather than simply cutting the hair as I moved the razor across my face like the original foils had, the new one grabs my skin and hair and drags them along before finally cutting. As a result of the painful dragging of the skin and hair before eventually cutting it, the shave is not as close since it isn't cutting the hair straight on as the razor with the original foils did. Now it hurts to get a lousy shave. Braun must want us to buy the new Pulsonic, but I'm not falling for it. They'll just mess up the foil and cutter again once a newer razor comes out.

B000GBMYC0-457.review_text: No where near the quality of the original replacement parts. Blades are farther apart, and the screen has LARGE slots holes. Everytime you use it, you will end up with shavings all over your chest and counter. Total garbage.

B000GBMYC0-279.review_title: Works fine in a Braun 8585 Activator
B000GBMYC0-279.review_text: These replacement heads work just fine on a Braun 8585 (which has the "Activator" system, whatever that is) in case anyone is wondering. I got a terrific shave after installing them on my 8585 today. I replaced my original foil after 30 months of use, as the cutter finally wore through the foil leaving a hole. I do not shave every day, as I feel better with a day's growth, sometimes even two or three if it's a weekend. This probably contributed to the phenomenal 30 month life of the original screen. For some reason this foil was $5 cheaper than the "Activator" 8000 series foil, so I got it. Add to it Amazon's free shipping and 15% discount for Subscribe & Save and it is an unbeatable deal.

B000GBMYC0-508.review_title: The package photo displayed for this product is not what ...
B000GBMYC0-508.review_text: The package photo displayed for this product is not what you will get when you order this. The package displayed here shows the original foil with the blue center, but instead you will receive the flat silver center. Also, the design of the holes in the foil shown on the package photo is different from what you actually get. What you will get is instead of what is shown on this package photo, is a Braun Series 5 51s which can be purchased from Amazon for much less than this falsely advertised product.

B000GBMYC0-549.review_title: The original lasted for 2 years, but this one 3 months
B000GBMYC0-549.review_text: I bought the pack on amazon from this vendor for my 8985. When installed, it didn't seem to fit perfectly as the original one. When shaving, you can tell it is not close to the skin as before. I shave everyday. 3 months later, some areas of my neck I shave started to feel itchy and painful at times, esp. when shaving. After awhile, I notice that the foil has 2 holes on it. HOW CAN THIS HAPPEN FOR ONLY 3 MONTHS? I still miss the original one comes w/ the shaver, close, smooth and lasted for 2 years. I bought this pack for the price but now I am going to thrown in 50% more to get it in store. Let's see how it goes.

B000GBMYC0-92.review_text: I recently purchased the complete foil & cutter block for my braun 8995 razor. B000GBMYC0-7.review_text: The original blades stayed sharp for about 5 years. The replacement was dull in 6 months. If this produce was graded by a teacher it would get an F.

B000GBMYC0-254.review_text: Wish I had ordered this a long time ago. What a difference. I didn't think my face could get more beautiful, but it's true. I'm a clean shaven walking piece of facial man meat now. Thank you Braun.

B000GBMYC0-75.review_title: His first comment after shaving was that his face felt like newborn skin

B000GBMYC0-70.review_text: Guys, the proper 360 Complete replacement cutters clearly says, "8000 Series" boldly on the package. Don't get the replacement foils with the terrible Honeycomb mesh pattern. The OEM Braun SmartFoil has a unique and effective, "flower" design, which scoops-up lying hairs and whiskers that sprout from odd directions.

B000GBMYC0-246.review_text: This is a counterfeit product from overseas. The package was in a foreign language and I sent the package to Braun and they confirmed that the product is fake. B000GBMYC0-408.review_title: Don't take a chance, buy the 30B replacement!
B000GBMYC0-408.review_text: I own an 8985 and it had been in desperate need of a replacement foil and cutter for some time. I hesitated spending the $35 or so since I had read so many bad reviews. Don't take a chance. Buy the 30B at $21 each with Prime free shipping. Thanks for the advice to those who tried this out first!

B000GBMYC0-26.review_text: Item works as described, even a little better. I was a little nervous about some of the negative review. But this replacement foil and cutter work just fine for my Braun 8000 series.

The first replacement foil and cutter I got him lasted about a year. The second replacement lasted about 8 months. Now this replacement is basically worthless. B000GBMYC0-157.review_text: This is the most you can do to make your razor like new again. Replacing the foil and cutter gives it a big boost in performance. Unfortunately, I don't think that boost lasts a long time -- maybe a couple of months. After that, it just doesn't give a great shave.

B000GBMYC0-321.review_text: Easy to install on shaver, and close quick shaves are back again! The price is slightly better than Target. Great value.....

B000GBMYC0-464.review_text: The outter foil arrived with a dent, making it impossible to clip onto the razor. I was also unable to bent it back since it is too delicate. I had to go to Target to buy a replacement.

B000GBMYC0-361.review_text: I've owned a Braun shaver for 2 or 3 years. It gave a great shave, but gradually and imperceptably the quality of the shave declined. It was taking longer to shave and even then it wasn't that great a result. Well, DUH! The blades had blunted after literally 100s of shaves. Foolishly, it never dawned on me to think about replacing the blades, until I finally read the note on the box of cleaning liquid. I ordered the Foil & Cutter Block from Amazon and it arrived quickly. I'm not at all techy so I wondered if I'd have trouble fiddling with tiny screwdrivers etc. No need to worry; you simply pull off the old one, pop on the new one, snap on the new foil cover and start shaving. I noticed the difference immediately. A much cleaner, quicker shave. If you own a Braun shaver and haven't replaced the cutter in 12+ months, I strongly suggest you do it now. It's like getting a brand new shaver.

B000GBMYC0-69.review_text: This replacement head made a huge difference in the quality of my husband's shave. He had put off replacing it, thinking it probably wouldn't make that big of a difference. Boy, was he wrong. It's just like having a new razor. It was also a good value.

B000GBMYC0-74.review_text: This is one of the best razors I have ever used. The new foil cutter block makes it just like new again.

B01DUYNJL4-229.review_title: Works as described. Use taller 3 oz cups with pump.
B01DUYNJL4-229.review_text: Bought the pump for my elderly mother-in-law who has difficulty lifting the larger size mouthwash bottles and opening the caps. Works fine for our needs. Pros: Fits Listerine Zero 1.5L bottles. Can't comment on whether it fits other brands or sizes but based on previous reviews, sounds like it doesn't fit other brands. Makes it easier to dispense product vs. lifting and pouring out product. Inexpensive solution - I paid $6.50 with free Prime shipping. Cons: Pump dispenses additional product as it releases/comes back up so be prepared for this and keep your cup beneath the spout the entire time until it has reset to the starting position. Spout tip is angled outwards so place your cup directly underneath the tip to keep product in cup. Pump flow is strong so definitely use a taller larger cup or you'll get splash back. I'd recommend the standard 3 oz Dixie type cups. I bought the tiny 3/4 oz paper medicine type cups thinking that would work but they're a tad too difficult to use with the pump.

B01DUYNJL4-380.review_title: I got this to keep my countertop clean
B01DUYNJL4-380.review_text: Before I got this pump, my bathroom counter perpetually had little crystals of dried listerine all over it. I conscientiously wiped down the outside of the bottle every single time I used the cap to measure mouthwash, but my husband’s habits were different than mine. So, listerine crystals. SO ANNOYING TO CLEAN. Well. I got this and a decorative cup to dispense into for our bathroom. My counters have never stayed so clean so long!!! 2 days ago I was brushing my teeth next to hubby and I saw him pick up the listerine bottle and squirt two pumps directly into his mouth and proceed to swish. So, that’s a thing that happens now. ¯\_(ツ)_/¯ PROS: •Keeps countertop clean •Entertains kids and adults by squirtgunning mouthwash into the oral cavity •Dispenses a consistent amount every time CONS: •Doesn’t exactly look chic on the counter •Encourages grown men to act like children. •1 pump is t quite enough to rinse- 2 is better for an adult. Maybe 1 pump for kids.

B01DUYNJL4-147.review_title: Use more than once with proper cleaning, fits perfectly on Listerine bottles.
B01DUYNJL4-147.review_text: Works great in a Listerine bottle, AND ONLY A LISTERINE BOTTLE! does not work with other brands. My remedy is to purchase 2 Listerine bottles, and once they’re gone, I run through the dishwasher, and refill with comparable mouthwash from Costco. By using 2, I can refill one immediately while the other one is in the dishwasher. The description says one-time use only. Definitely not one-time use at this cost!!! After each bottle of mouthwash, I pump hot water through the pump device to clean it out. Has worked well since I started using these. The pump is especially useful for kids that use mouthwash. My kids always make a mess or leave backwash when getting mouthwash direct from the bottle.

B01DUYNJL4-9.review_text: Love my new listerine pump. It help me to dispense better my mouthwash to last it longer and keep my bathroom cleaner by avoiding spills. The only negative points (that's why I removed a star), this pump only works with listerine brand and doesn't work with the store brand listerine bottles and the instruction booklet said that you will need to replace it after every bottle (no planing to do that).

B01DUYNJL4-428.review_title: Apparently for Listerine bottles only. Not universal fit.
B01DUYNJL4-428.review_text: Seems decently made. I can confirm that this pump does not mate with Costco's Kirkland brand of mouthwash in the 1.5 liter bottle, No surprise there. The listing does specify Listerine. I'll buy :Listerine and reuse the bottle with the Costco or Sams Club mouthwash.

B01DUYNJL4-101.review_title: Be aware this is LARGE. Very large. (Read on.)
B01DUYNJL4-101.review_text: I was looking forward to using this pump, rather than taking the cover off the Listerine bottle every time to use it. Although the items was "as described" (which had no dimension listed, only that it fit either the 1 or 1.5 liter bottle of Listerine ONLY) I had no idea how HUGE this would be, once attached to at least a one liter bottle. The pump goes approx 2 inches above the lip of the already large bottle, with no options for use on smaller sized bottle. I already had a 500 ml bottle, which is about as large as I'd want at the bathroom sink, but I had to go out and find a liter bottle (or larger) in order to use this. Had I been able to purchase one that fit the 500ml (1 pint) bottle, I would be far happier. To add insult to injury, Amazon prime wouldn't sell me the 1 L bottle. Once I tried to purchase it, the product became a Prime Fresh product, which is a service I don't use. Just be aware, this isn't a dainty bottle on your bathroom counter sink. Once attached, it looks like a commercial sized bottle. Would not re-purchase.

B01DUYNJL4-173.review_title: Hard to find item accoding to my dentist. They use this in their office.
B01DUYNJL4-173.review_text: I use mouth rinse twice a day as does my wife, so this gets 4 uses, 10-12 pumps a day. Much better than the decanter we had that started leaking. There is some drippage from the spout, so you will want a small catch plate under it to contain the splash.

B01DUYNJL4-85.review_text: The BEST purchase ever! I buy the large bottles of Listerine from Costco and I'm sure as most know they are large, heavy & bulky which makes it hard to dispense the right amount and not very comfortable when picking up. Wasn't sure if I should buy this after reading some reviews saying that they do not fit the Costco bottles, or that they were as big as the ones at the Denist office. WELL for starters they fit PERFECTLY & work just as well! And for being as large as the ones at the Dentist office, not even close!!!!!!!! My son is a Dentist and trust me the one he has is A LOT bigger!!! I put one in every bathroom in the house!!! They dispense the right amount & make for better hygiene. I couldn't be happier! It makes life easier for us! Thank you for these AMAZING pumps!!!

B01DUYNJL4-111.review_title: good for dispensing Listerine mouthwash without waste
B01DUYNJL4-111.review_text: i've been searching for a solution to using my 1 litre Listerine. usually, i have to squeeze the cap and rotate to remove it. then, pour enough mouthwash into the cap and swig. the whole process of squeezing to remove the cap is bothersome along with sometimes pouring out too much. i purchased this pump to put on my bottle, and now i can dispense the quantity i need into a small glass by measured amounts. i don't waste Listerine anymore by pouring out too much and having to pour the excess back into the bottle or down the drain.

Two things: As everyone else has mentioned, this is labeled as a single use item. I have not followed these guidelines and continue to use my pump. Also, as others have stated, this does not fit the generic/walmart brand bottles. I bought an expensive Listerine bottle, only to accidently throw it out! DOH! Most shower caps made in China were probably also to be sold on the Asian market, because anything made for Asians is too small for the rest of the world. None of them would cover my whole head and the water would always wet my hair. Finding this cap was literally a lifesaver. Even though it's also made in China (obviously), it was most likely intended for sale on the Western market. It is REALLY stretchy and most importantly it covers my hair fully. I can tie up my hair in a bun and there still will be room. My hair NEVER gets wet in this cap. This is my second time purchasing it. The first one I ordered on eBay and it was about $4 there! I will now buy from Amazon and will always stick with this amazing cap. Too bad it's only in one pattern though, I would love to see more designs. TIP: Hang it up to dry so it will last you a long time. The first cap I made a mistake with and neglected letting it dry after showering and it got covered in mold after a while.

B00DT4757A-18.review_text: More Than Clean is a combination scrub and masque recommended for morning use. You work it into your skin for a couple of minutes, then leave it on for a few minutes before rinsing it off. There are no unpronounceable ingredients in it, and it smells like peppermint. It's a very thick bilious colored liquid dispensed through the bottle cap. I've used it four times with great results on my skin and one unexpected but welcome side effect. The MTC initially feels like mud, but there's a really refreshing tingle that's just great first thing in the morning. If you're of the generation that used a product called Seabreeze, that's exactly the sensation, only stronger. The tingle doesn't go away until the stuff is rinsed off, either, and skin feels really clean. I have some large pores around my nose, and they're thoroughly flattened by this stuff. If you have dry skin, go easy with this, and use a good moisturizer afterwards. I have an oily T Zone with dry cheeks, and have learned to concentrate on my oily areas with the MTC, with just a quick once over on the dryer areas of my face. I've been using this just before showering in the morning, and then using the shower to rinse it off--and here's the unexpected side effect: my miserable early spring sinuses have improved! I think it's the herbs in the product coupled with the steam from the shower, but my whole sinus area feels SO much more open. Hooray! I'm thrilled with this product. My skin feels awake and energized, and the products I use daily--serums, moisturizer, and BB cream--just sink right in after use. I was provided a bottle of More Than Clean for review, and am delighted to do so. I really like the effect on my skin, and love breathing easier. Win all around!

That being said, there were some brushes that were a total miss in the collection whereas others are my all-time favorite. While I didn't like the flat foundation brush or the flat angle brush at all, I thoroughly enjoyed the round dome brush, the tapered concealer brush, and the angled blush brush! However, you shouldn't let this dissuade you from buying the brushes. Keep in mind that this review is entirely subjective, therefore the brushes that I listed as horrible may not be so bad for the prospective buyer (and vice-versa) UPDATE 6/20/20: After consistent use, about 4 of the brushes broke, rendering me with 13 left.
